meta.name: ZorbaHealth Peak UX
meta.description: Structured design DNA for the Peak UX redesign of the current ZorbaHealth web and Expo apps. This evolves the shipped indigo clinical system into a calmer patient experience and a denser hospital console while preserving routes, roles, feature scope, and data states.
source_references: ui-ux-pro-max: patient design-system search, hospital design-system search, color healthcare trust, typography clinical calm legible, ux accessibility forms navigation
motion-design: Premium patient archetype and Corporate hospital archetype

Note: docs/design/current-state-dna.json was not present in the repository during this pass; the current-state baseline was inferred from source code and the original current-state prompt until the Figma source file is supplied.

color.palette_type: split-complementary clinical indigo with cyan, green, and warm orange highlights

primary.role: Trust anchor, primary actions, active navigation, focus ring, consent-positive emphasis

secondary.role: Clinical information, patient reassurance, quiet secondary surfaces

accent.role: Warm highlight only: countdowns, next-best-action accents, non-destructive attention

neutral.usage: Light patient canvas, white cards, slate text, slate borders; dense hospital screens use the same scale with tighter contrast and less decorative color.

color.contrast_strategy: AA-first foreground/background pairs; patient screens use calm high contrast with fewer simultaneous signals, hospital screens use compact labels and status color paired with text/icons so color is never the only cue.

font_families.heading: Lora for patient-facing welcome and reassurance moments; Plus Jakarta Sans for clinical console headings
font_families.body: Plus Jakarta Sans, fallback Inter/system sans
font_families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: Two-family direction: warmer patient headlines for calm reassurance, legible humanist/geometric sans for all UI and dense hospital data.

spacing.content_density: Patient: comfortable; Hospital: compact dashboard density
spacing.section_rhythm: Patient screens use 24-40px between major groups; hospital screens use 12-20px within panels and 24px between work zones.

layout.grid_system: Responsive shell: web 1440 desktop with sidebar/rail and task-first content; mobile 390x844 with top status, task home, and max five primary tabs.
layout.max_content_width: 1280px web console, 1120px patient content, full-width mobile safe area
layout.columns: Patient web 12-column with 7/5 task split; hospital web 12-column with triage strip and dense tables; mobile single column with bottom navigation.
layout.alignment_tendency: Strict grid for hospital console, softer grouped hierarchy for patient surfaces

shape.border_usage: Subtle 1px borders on cards, fields, PHI containers, and safety-critical groupings
shape.divider_style: Low-contrast slate/indigo dividers with explicit section labels

elevation.shadow_style: Soft clinical depth, never neumorphic; hospital console keeps shadows very low for scan speed
elevation.depth_cues: Border, tonal surface, shadow, and fixed triage/consent affordances

iconography.stroke_weight: 2px web Lucide, platform default Ionicons mobile
iconography.preferred_set: Lucide for web, Ionicons for Expo mobile

motion.entrance_pattern: Patient: Card Entrance (Premium), 20px y, opacity plus delayed shadow/content; Hospital: Corporate triage updates, 0-3% overshoot, 200-400ms.
motion.exit_pattern: Exit is 60-70% of entrance duration with accelerated easing; reduced motion swaps spatial movement for instant state and subtle color/outline change.
motion.philosophy: Motion is functional and named. Every animated note traces to Premium patient or Corporate hospital archetypes; never more than one or two key animated elements per view.

components.button_style: Rounded 12-16px, clear primary/secondary/destructive hierarchy, visible focus-visible ring, loading state, no color-only meaning
components.input_style: Persistent labels, helper/error text below field, 48px minimum web height and 44pt mobile target
components.card_style: Task cards with top status signal, PHI boundary annotation, low shadow, and clear primary action
components.navigation_pattern: Patient task-first: Home, Care, Records, Privacy plus persistent welfare/emergency action. Hospital: triage strip plus role tabs Home, Summary, Meetings, Appointments, Staff, Consent, Alerts, Audit.
components.modal_style: Sheet/dialog with clear escape route and extra confirmation for destructive or medical-risk actions
components.list_style: Dense hospital lists with filters and provenance; patient lists group by next action and recency
components.component_notes: Build Figma variants for default, hover, focus-visible, pressed, disabled, loading, and error. Annotate PHI regions, focus order, reduced-motion behavior, and decision count.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A calm care command center where consent is the spine and the next safe action is always visible.
aesthetic.era_influence: Modern healthcare SaaS with patient-grade warmth and clinical dashboard discipline
aesthetic.genre: medical SaaS portal and staff operations console

visual_language.complexity: Moderate: simplified patient IA, dense but organized hospital IA
visual_language.ornamentation: Low; warm highlights and status bands only where they clarify attention
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous on patient home and booking, compact in hospital tables and triage strips
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Top-heavy priority zone above the fold followed by grouped supporting detail
visual_language.focal_strategy: One glance, one truth: next best action or highest-risk clinical queue leads every screen
visual_language.contrast_level: High functional contrast with restrained brand color
visual_language.texture_usage: None beyond subtle tonal surfaces and existing web mesh/gradient concepts

composition.hierarchy_method: Priority bands, status chips, card grouping, readable type scale, and stable action placement
composition.balance_type: Patient: soft asymmetric task cards; Hospital: strict grid and tables
composition.flow_direction: Top priority to timeline/detail to action confirmation
composition.grouping_strategy: Care, Records, Privacy, and Safety instead of equal flat tabs
composition.negative_space_role: Creates calm on patient screens and scan lanes on hospital screens

imagery.photo_treatment: No stock photography required for app surfaces
imagery.illustration_style: Minimal explanatory diagrams only for QR consent and degraded video mode
imagery.graphic_elements: Status strips, consent badges, provenance chips, focus order markers
imagery.pattern_usage: Current landing mesh/dot ideas may remain as restrained background texture, not on dense work screens

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate, plain-language, localized near the action; undo for consent grant/revoke where safe
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Subtle lift or tonal state on web; never required for discovery
interaction_feel.transition_personality: Patient Premium calm glide; Hospital Corporate snappy and controlled
interaction_feel.loading_style: Skeleton/loading card with retained layout and clear label
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Low to medium; only task progress, status updates, and confirmations animate

brand_voice_in_ui.formality: Patient: conversational eighth-grade reading level; Hospital: concise clinical precision
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Direct verbs tied to patient/staff outcomes
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Explain the missing prerequisite and offer the next safe action
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Cause plus recovery path, no blame

overview.fallback_strategy: Respect reduced motion: remove spatial movement, keep instant state and semantic color/text change.
overview.primary_technology: GSAP for web implementation handoff; React Native Animated/Reanimated-compatible native APIs for mobile handoff

background_effects.type: subtle gradient mesh on marketing/arrival only
background_effects.description: Retain the current indigo/orange/sky mesh lineage for non-work surfaces; work surfaces use static clinical backgrounds.
background_effects.technology: CSS gradients on web, static View backgrounds on mobile

params.speed: none on work screens; optional slow 8s aurora on marketing only

particle_systems.description: No particle system in the redesign baseline.

3d_elements.description: No 3D elements planned for the clinical product UI.

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: Below-fold marketing and long rationale pages only
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: Card Entrance (Premium) for patient-context content; Corporate fade/translate for hospital-context content

text_effects.description: Current aurora/shiny text is reserved for marketing; Peak UX product screens use stable readable text.

image_effects.description: No image effects on app screens.

canvas_drawings.description: The current app has a canvas flickering grid component for marketing decoration; Peak UX product surfaces do not rely on canvas.

svg_animations.description: No SVG animation in product surfaces; current marketing dotted map animation remains outside core clinical flows.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Patient Home next-best-action card and appointment-confirmed state use three motion layers: primary card entrance/confirmation, secondary icon/status shift, ambient low-opacity accent pulse. Hospital triage strip uses Corporate live-update motion at 200-400ms with cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1) and 0-3% overshoot. All motion annotations in Figma should name these patterns so implementation can map them to GSAP on web and native animation APIs on mobile.
